summary: Tutor Perini Corp filed an 8-K regarding the issuance of $400M in 6.625% Senior Notes due 2033 at par. The proceeds, along with cash on hand, will be used to redeem $400M of 11.875% Senior Notes due 2029. This is a routine debt refinancing: the company is replacing higher-cost debt with lower-cost debt, not executing a special situation like a tender offer, acquisition, or restructuring. The notes were offered to QIBs under Rule 144A. No third-party involvement, no premium, no expected change in equity. The filing is informational under Items 1.01, 2.03, 8.01, and 9.01.
